div.div: SC2002 Restaurant Rush - Stage 3 Class Diagram (SCE1 Group 5)

g.text: at most one task per turn}
Stage 3 extends the Stage 2 diagram; members verified against current Java source
VIP discount = 10% before Happy Hour (if active).
Critic selects Pasta; falls back if Pasta is absent.
Six slots: 4 Regular + 1 VIP + 1 Critic; shuffle positions.
Initialize arrival plan after seed selection, at first turn.
Waiter prices; Cashier and UI use Order's locked bill.
The loss hook replaces the fixed SATISFACTION_LOSS.}
{leaf} = Java final operation; italics = abstract; underlining = static; {readOnly} = final field
{Stage 3 Host: one queued customer seated per turn,
in addition to the Waiter's task; no ordering or serving.
Happy Hour is offered first in the Host menu.
Activating it does not consume the Host's task.}
{Once per game; activate before Host/Waiter/Chef acts.
Active on the activation turn and the following turn.
Each active turn starts with +15 satisfaction, max 100,
only for WAITING, SEATED or ORDERED customers.
Customer discount first, then 20% Happy Hour discount;
each step uses integer cents, half cents rounded up.
Waiter locks the bill and promotion flag in Order.
Orders taken before activation keep their old bill;
discounted bills persist after Happy Hour expires.
Menu(seed) adds one combo to the three base items:
Price = 90% of component total, rounded to cents;
preparation units = sum of both components.
Components are constructor inputs, not stored fields.
Regular/VIP use the seeded six-slot food plan;
